Title: Widgets Limited by BE Data Readiness — Mock vs Real Data Explicitly Flagged (Ivan Kalachikov, VCST-5485)
Section: Storefront > Sales Rep > Hub Dashboard > Data Readiness
Preconditions:
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:SR_REP_PRIMARY]
Per Ivan Kalachikov's VCST-5485 JIRA comment (2026-07-17, fetched live this session): "The set of implemented widgets on the page is limited by BE data readiness. Statistic widgets are built on mock data yet." This case is a DELIBERATE regression tripwire: it does not assert the widgets are real (they may still be mock per the comment) — it asserts the CURRENT real-vs-mock status can be objectively determined per widget, so a future promotion from mock to real is caught (or a regression from real back to mock is caught).
Steps:
[NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}/company/dashboard
[WAIT] hub dashboard widgets rendered
[ASSERT] for EACH widget (stat widgets, Active Projects, My Customers counters, Top Sellers), record whether its rendered values are traceable to a live GraphQL response (real) or appear static/unchanging across reloads and unrelated to seeded data (mock)
Assertions:
[STATE] a definitive real/mock classification is recorded for each of the 4 widget families this run, to be diffed against the next sync's classification {SPEC}
[NOTE] this case does not itself PASS/FAIL on mock data being present — mock data on a widget is EXPECTED per Ivan Kalachikov's comment until VCST-5309/5362/5368 fully land; only an UNDOCUMENTED regression (a previously-real widget reverting to mock, or vice versa without a corresponding suite update) is the actual failure signal {SPEC}
Cross_Layer_Checks: [API] cross-reference each widget's classification against whether its backing query (salesRepCustomerOrderStatistics/CartStatistics/Counts/TopSellers) actually fires on page load
Failure_Signals: a widget silently flips from real to mock (or mock to real) between syncs without this suite being updated to match — that drift, not the mock data itself, is the defect this case guards against
References: VCST-5485; New: TLC sync 2026-07-23 (PR #2395); source: Ivan Kalachikov JIRA comment on VCST-5485, fetched live 2026-07-23
